feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 26 May 2026 4:36pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 26 May 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Locally Strong Winds Wednesday morning.


##Synopsis##

High pressure is centred to the northwest of Ireland extending a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Mainly north or northwest force 3 or 4, but locally variable 3 or less in places at first, veering east or northeast 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the southern to central parts of the area overnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming mainly slight this evening, and slight or moderate tonight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 4 or 5, occasionally 6, increasing east or southeast 5 or 6 occasionally 7 mainly in southern to central waters Wednesday evening. Decreasing 4 or 5 Thursday morning, then veering south or southwest in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate for a time overnight into Thursday.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but with occasional showers developing overnight into Thursday, clearing Thursday morning. Risk of mist/fog patches later on.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in any showers and poor or very poor in any mist/fog patches later.
